export.encoding: lossless PNG optimize only; no crop, resize, recolor, art repaint or retouch

method: Actual cached canvas textures and normal baked cats, unchanged aa9 engine, unique temporary snapshot modules with runtime SHA sentinel; all 14 poses t=.4 and idle/windup/strike at four t values; exact attributes/indices and skinned world vertex equality; no new tests or source modification.

visualReview.result: No source-specific revision requested. The centered point mask, open irregular rosettes, light-ground asymmetric cow patches, dark-ground warm tortie patches and four forehead petals remain distinct in the reviewed images. No obvious hard UV seam at the actual reviewed scales and directions, without claiming mathematical zero seams.
visualReview.leastSatisfied: Butterfly has low contrast against blue fur, and its two lower petals are hard to distinguish at battle scale. Rosettes compress on small tail spheres and are much clearer on the skull than on tail segments.
visualReview.engineLimits: Current coatTexture maps only skull, exposed shin and unoverridden tail balls. Ears/paws/cheek tufts/muzzle/collar/sleeves use plain materials. Point cannot darken ears, paws or non-ring last light tail ball from patterns.ts alone. Ring odd tail balls use stripe or engine fallback color; repeated body UV cannot target a whole-tail position or recolor those fixed ring balls.
visualReview.samplingLimits: All skinned vertices and transforms at 266 static cases and 228 finite time samples, yaw32. This does not prove arbitrary camera angles, continuous motion, pixel-perfect UV continuity or every frame face visibility. No new eye ray occlusion audit was performed because geometry attributes/indices and posed vertices equal baseline and target textures are opaque.
visualReview.ssrCoverageClarification: Author measured 19 target users x2 modes x2 repeated calls =76. Independent QA separately measured all 77 real users x2 modes =154 null results; these are distinct coverages.
